keyResults.statement: The pairwise linking numbers together with the triple linking number classify a three-component link in the 3-sphere up to link homotopy, corresponding to the Pontryagin invariants of an associated characteristic map from the 3-torus to the 2-sphere.
keyResults.useForFolio: Sources the classification statement that ex:hadron-proton and conj:borromean-quark currently assert with no reference, and supplies the homotopy-theoretic reading of the triple invariant the confinement argument implicitly uses.

keyResults.statement: When all pairwise linking numbers vanish the triple linking number is given by an integral formula, invariant under orientation-preserving rigid motions of the 3-sphere and expressible as the helicity of a related vector field on the 3-torus.
keyResults.useForFolio: A geometric/analytic representative for the triple linking invariant, in the same helicity register the framework already uses for linking weights.
